notes.title: New Trailer + Screenshots
notes.content:
Hi guys,

We're happy to show you our new trailer and screenshots for Scarlet Deer Inn! 

[previewyoutube=WKIjNh4Re-I;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]ABOUT[/b]
Scarlet Deer Inn is an embroidered exploration adventure game with an emotional story, dark underground full of monsters and a setting inspired by Slavic folklore. The only thing keeping you from certain death is a torch.

Each character frame is physically embroidered and the music is made using traditional instruments.
[list]
[*] Meet interesting characters and experience moving stories filled with unforgettable moments.
[*]Look for shortcuts in the dark to make further attempts easier.
[*]Enjoy beautiful hand-painted backgrounds and traditional animation.
[*]Listen to medieval-inspired folk music played on traditional instruments.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39879521/ba5a7c87f96e901a86ca77ec74d3151a4f71a09e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39879521/3b3f72d12f449fcb1c421ed4258a0eb170f6b3d7.png[/img]

[b]THE STORY[/b]
Uncover the story of Elise. A mother of two. She's not particularly special, there are no heroic epics written about her.
An unexpected tragedy forces her to explore places full of unusual and interesting, but also dark and evil events.


[b]THE TEAM[/b]
Attu Games is a husband and wife team from the Czech Republic. We're trying to do all the stuff ourselves. From painting and animation to storytelling, programming, music making and publishing.
Scarlet Deer Inn is inspired by amazing Studio Ghibli films, the fantastic world of The Witcher games, medieval Europe and Slavic folklore.

Don't forget to add Scarlet Deer Inn to your wishlist!

Eva and Lukas
